newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba Oel to sell Vestolen unit DSM -paper.
newsitem.headline: Veba Oel to sell Vestolen unit DSM -paper.

text.p: German oil refiner Veba Oel AG plans to sell its subsidiary Vestolen GmbH to Dutch group DSM, a German newspaper reported on Tuesday.
DSM plans a considerable expansion of Vestolen's Gelsenkirchen site and wants to invest up to one billion marks in the coming years, Westdeutsche Allgemeine Zeitung reported.
Vestolen generates annual sales of 500 million marks with polyolefine products, the report said.
The report said Veba Oel had declined to comment.
The company has called a news conference for 0800 GMT on Tuesday to disclose what it called an important strategic decision.
Veba Oel is a subsidiary of diversified electricity utility Veba.
